 Bench At Aurangabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Mr. S. G. Ladda, Advocate for Applicants
  Mr. S. P. Joshi, App for Respondent-State
 ...
 Coram : Mehroz K. Pathan, J.
 Dated : 07.11.2025

PER COURT :
1. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 28.11.2025.
The learned APP waives notice on behalf of respondent - State.
2. Looking to the nature of the allegations that the dispute arises out of business transactions relating to the supply of pipes.
The learned counsel for the applicants submits that they have supplied 1,308 pipes, and only a few pipes remain to be supplied, amounting to approximately Rs. 65,00,000/-.
It is further submitted that there was an agreement between the applicant and the complainant which did not materialize, resulting in the registration of the FIR.

4. Looking to the nature of allegations, which appear to arise from a purely civil transaction, I am inclined to grant the ad interim relief till the time the investigation papers are made available.

ORDER A) In the event of arrest in connection with Crime No. 98 of 2025, dated 05.03.2025, registered with Satara Police Station, Dist. Chh. Sambhajingar for the offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 and 120B of IPC, the applicants shall be released on bail on furnishing PR Bond of Rs. 50,000/-
each, with one or two sureties in the like amount.
